# **Software Requirements Specification: Learner-Facing Interface for Multi-Certificate Placement, Adaptive Learning Path, and Practice Subsystems**

## **1\. Operational Boundaries, Non-Objectives, and Design System Mandates**

### **1.1 System Context and Clean-Slate Interface Mandate**

This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) defines the complete learner-facing user interface, screen architecture, interaction grammar, state vocabulary, and copy contract for a multi-certificate English examination preparation platform1. Because the underlying adaptive placement subsystem and the sliding-window learning path engine are undergoing a complete delete-and-rebuild replacement, every learner-facing screen that renders a proficiency band, a study schedule, a practice session, or a diagnostic score is specified here from first principles against the new behavioral contracts rather than patched over legacy views1. The legacy diagnostic and path machinery suffered from compounding structural defects, including a 24-question TOEIC placement paper with zero items at difficulty levels 4 and 5 that could not separate B2 from C1, uncalibrated 1–5 integer difficulty labels with no mapping to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), a dual-writer database constraint failure on asynchronous free-response grading, and a static four-week study plan that terminated permanently at day 282. Rebuilding both backend engines simultaneously creates a single architectural window to align every screen with true multi-dimensional proficiency measurement and continuous rolling-horizon scheduling1.  
The platform serves candidates preparing for five distinct English certificates whose examined skill modalities and native reporting scales differ structurally1. While internal ability estimation, multistage adaptive item routing, and topic capability tracking operate on a unified CEFR continuum (![][image1], spanning discrete bands Pre-A1 through C2 paired with an integer intra-band position ![][image2]), the learner-facing interface dynamically adapts its layout geometry, navigation entry points, and score projections to the exact skill set examined by the learner's active certificate1.

| Certificate Configuration Code | Canonical Certificate Display Name | Examined Skills Rendered in UI | Suppressed Skills (Stored in DB if Present, Hidden in UI) | Native Scale Projected Alongside CEFR Coordinate |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| TOEIC\_LR | TOEIC Listening & Reading (4-Skill Track) | Listening, Reading, Speaking, Writing | None | L: 5–495, R: 5–495, S: 0–200, W: 0–200 (Ceiling: C1) |
| IELTS | IELTS Academic & General Training | Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking | None | Overall & Per-Skill: 0.0–9.0 in 0.5 increments (A1–C2) |
| VSTEP | VSTEP.3–5 (Vietnam National Test) | Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking | None | Scale: 0.0–10.0 in 0.5 increments (B1 at 4.0 to C1 at 8.5–10.0) |
| TOEIC\_CAT | TOEIC Multi-Stage Adaptive (L & R) | Listening, Reading | Speaking, Writing | Combined: 10–990; Per-Skill: 5–495 (CAT\_B1, CAT\_B2) |
| TOEIC\_SW | TOEIC Speaking & Writing | Speaking, Writing | Listening, Reading | Combined: 0–400; Per-Skill: 0–200 (SW\_B1, SW\_B2) |

Two product-wide invariants govern every visual and textual element across this specification1. First, placement sittings, learning path steps, and standalone free drilling are permanently free of charge; initiating, resuming, or retaking a placement sitting or practice step never generates a credit ledger row or invokes billing deduction logic, so no screen in these flows may render credit balances, billing deductions, or paywall gates1. Second, algorithmic authority is strictly separated from generative artificial intelligence: AI models (LLMs and acoustic prosody evaluators) are restricted exclusively to scoring productive free responses (Speaking and Writing) against explicit analytical rubrics and authoring diagnostic narrative commentary, whereas item selection, stage routing, score aggregation, band resolution, and weekly path synthesis are executed by deterministic code1. Consequently, no interface label, banner, or loading state may imply that an AI model chose what the learner studies or altered their learning route1.

### **1.2 Excluded Operational Domains**

Four adjacent product areas lie outside the boundaries of this specification1. Graphical administrative and content authoring interfaces—including bulk per-skill JSON CLI/API ingestion (D20), four-gate cross-model verification pipelines, and post-launch psychometric item quarantine telemetry—are backend workflows excluded from the learner interface1. Commercial packaging, pricing tiers, wallet management, and checkout flows are similarly excluded because all placement and practice operations are unconditionally free1. Furthermore, by recorded architectural trade-off, the application targets a desktop-first 1440×900 viewport to accommodate high-density 200-question examination sittings where the passage, answer grid, clock, and sync status share one screen; mobile and narrow-viewport layouts are not designed for v1, though Section 7.2 documents the exact structural mechanisms that would fail on mobile viewports1. Finally, sensory and neurodivergent accessibility accommodations—such as visual sign-language or transcript substitutes for deaf candidates in Listening and orthographic error exemptions for dyslexic candidates in Writing—are excluded from v1 by owner directive and cataloged as non-destructive v2 architectural hooks in Section 7.31.

Where the high-level summary in Section 2 or Section 5 of the UI brief exhibits tension with the mathematical or state-machine rules of the Placement SRS2 or the Learning Path SRS3, the interface architecture follows the authoritative SRS contracts and reconciles the screen behavior as specified in the table below1.

Outside formal sittings, dropping offline shows the top Sign Gold banner (U16) and disables the current item's submit button immediately without local queuing, while preserving items already synced to draft\_payload (FR-STEP-04)1. |

### **1.4 The "Bảng hiệu phòng thi" Design System Specification**

The visual language **"Bảng hiệu phòng thi"** (Exam-Room Signboard) is a strict architectural constraint that rejects the default pale-blue SaaS card grid1. Every component, layout container, and interactive state across all learner-facing screens must obey the token and structural rules defined in the table below; any CSS property or component pattern that violates them—such as rounded corners, drop shadows, gradients, blur filters, chat bubbles, or icon-only buttons—is a build defect1.

| Token Category | Token Identifier | Value / CSS Rule | Mandatory Semantic & Structural Usage |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Geometry & Depth** | radius-none / shadow-none | border-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; background-image: none; | Zero rounded corners, zero drop shadows, zero gradients, zero glass/blur effects across all panels, buttons, inputs, badges, and modals1. |
| **Keylines & Rules** | border-frame-ink | 2px solid \#14181d | Outer structural boundary for every signboard panel, primary card, modal, button, and active section container1. |
| **Keylines & Rules** | border-rule-soft | 1px solid \#ccd2d6 | Interior tabular dividers, row separators, inactive option frames, and intra-panel grid lines1. |
| **Surface Palette** | surface-wall | \#eef0f1 | Global viewport background canvas (the exam-room wall) against which painted signboard panels sit1. |
| **Surface Palette** | surface-painted | \#ffffff | Default interior fill for all signboard panels, data tables, and unselected interactive controls1. |
| **Surface Palette** | surface-active-invert | Background \#14181d / Text \#ffffff | **Active / Selected State**: Selected MCQ options, active sidebar navigation items, and active filter tabs invert to a solid ink block with white text; never use pale colour washes or tints for active selection1. |
| **Typography Palette** | text-ink / text-muted | Primary: \#14181d / Secondary: \#5c6570 | High-contrast body/header ink and secondary metadata/caption text1. |
| **Semantic Sign Colours** | sign-blue | \#0b4ea2 | **The Learner's Own Act**: Primary call-to-action button fill (with \#ffffff text and 2px solid \#14181d frame) and current active question ring1. |
| **Semantic Sign Colours** | sign-gold | \#f2b705 | **Attention & Mark**: Flagged exam items, "Chưa đo được" unmeasured skill panel border (2px solid \#f2b705), ![][image10]\-day exam countdown badge, reduced-confidence notice, and offline banner1. Always paired with \#14181d text for contrast1. |
| **Semantic Sign Colours** | sign-red | \#b31217 | **Refusal & Danger**: Hard validation errors, failed grading alerts requiring action, unrealistic goal feasibility warning, and destructive confirmation actions1. |
| **Semantic Sign Colours** | sign-green | \#0a6b3c | **Open Condition & Correctness**: Verified correct responses, met target bands, unlocked Free Drilling state, and feasible / READY verdicts1. |
| **Type Voices** | font-reading | Sans-serif/serif reading face (e.g., Inter / Source Serif) | Reading passages, question stems, option prose, lesson explanations, and streamed AI diagnostic commentary1. |
| **Type Voices** | font-signage | Condensed uppercase display face (text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-weight: 700\) | Panel headers, placards, state badges, skill labels, and table column headers1. |
| **Type Voices** | font-mono | Monospace tabular face (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) | **Every number in the product**: CEFR band numbers (B2 · 71), timers (14:32), item counts (08/10), accuracy percentages (80%), word counts (184 từ), dates (04/11/2026), and rubric scores (4.5/6.0)1. Rendering any numeral in font-reading is a defect1. |
| **Iconography** | icon-drawn-svg | 16×16px or 20×20px 1.5px-stroke SVG in \#14181d or \#ffffff | Must sit immediately beside an explicit text label; icon-only buttons, emoji, and raw Unicode dingbats are strictly prohibited1. |

The legacy learner interface sprawled across roughly 60 fragmented views, including 12 placement views, 11 practice views, 7 speaking views, 7 writing views, and disconnected weakness analysis pages1. The rebuilt architecture consolidates the entire assessment, planning, and practice lifecycle into **19 canonical screens** organized under the six-item global sidebar (Home, Path, Practice, Writing, Speaking, Exams per Decision U7) and the Profile settings view (U23)1.

## **3\. Per-Screen Functional and Visual Specifications**

### **3.1 Global Application Shell, Sidebar, and Profile Certificate Switcher (SCR-SH-01, SCR-PR-01)**

#### **3.1.1 Purpose and Learner Question**

The Global Application Shell (SCR-SH-01) frames every non-sitting view at the target 1440×900 desktop resolution1. It answers which certificate context is currently active, provides direct one-click entry to the six primary functional doors (U7), and surfaces urgent temporal or connectivity conditions (U22, U16)1.

#### **3.1.2 Layout Architecture and Design System Rules**

The viewport is divided by 2px solid \#14181d ink keylines into a fixed left vertical navigation signboard (220px wide), a fixed top status header (56px high), and a scrollable \#eef0f1 wall canvas (1220×844px)1. Within the left sidebar (U7), the interface renders six stacked rectangular signboard rows (height: 48px, border-bottom: 1px solid \#ccd2d6) labeled TRANG CHỦ (Home), LỘ TRÌNH (Path), LUYỆN TẬP (Practice), VIẾT (Writing), NÓI (Speaking), and ĐỀ THI (Exams)1. Writing and Speaking remain permanently split out into their own top-level doors because learners previously failed to locate productive practice when it was buried inside a generic practice menu, while Path occupies its own dedicated door so the rolling schedule exists as a first-class mental model1. Each row pairs a 16×16px drawn SVG icon with its condensed uppercase label, and the active route inverts to a solid \#14181d ink block with \#ffffff text and icon (§4)1. On two-skill certificates (TOEIC\_CAT and TOEIC\_SW), the six sidebar items remain fixed in position so navigation muscle memory never breaks1. When the active certificate is TOEIC\_CAT (which examines only Listening and Reading), the VIẾT and NÓI sidebar rows display a secondary monospace tag \[KHÔNG THI\] in \#5c6570; clicking either row opens a single-panel signboard notice stating that TOEIC\_CAT examines only Listening and Reading and directing the learner to LUYỆN TẬP or to /profile if they wish to switch certificates1. Conversely, on TOEIC\_SW, clicking LUYỆN TẬP routes directly to Speaking and Writing free drills3.  
Across the top status header (U22, U23), three read-only placards sit on the left and a profile trigger sits on the right, separated by 1px solid \#ccd2d6 vertical rules1. The first placard is the Active Certificate Placard (U23), rendered as a static uppercase badge (such as CHỨNG CHỈ: IELTS ACADEMIC & GENERAL) with no dropdown chevron and no click-to-switch menu, preventing accidental one-click certificate switches that previously looked like catastrophic data loss1. The second placard displays the target band in monospace (such as MỤC TIÊU: B2 · IELTS 6.5)1. The third placard is the Exam Date and Countdown Indicator (U22): when the target exam date is more than 14 calendar days away, it renders in standard \#ffffff fill with \#14181d monospace text (NGÀY THI: 15/03/2027) because a perpetual 365-day countdown is visual noise1. Once 14 calendar days or fewer remain (0 \< D\_remaining \<= 14), the placard background switches to Sign Gold \#f2b705 with \#14181d ink text and a drawn clock SVG (CÒN 12 NGÀY TỚI NGÀY THI (16/11/2026)) to communicate actionable near-term urgency1.

#### **3.1.3 Certificate Switching Behavior (SCR-PR-01 — Answering §6.5 Q15 & U23)**

Per Decision U23, changing the active certificate lives inside HỒ SƠ & CÀI ĐẶT (/profile, SCR-PR-01) inside a dedicated 2px solid \#14181d panel titled CHUYỂN ĐỔI CHỨNG CHỈ MỤC TIÊU1. Because each certificate maintains an isolated learning path (P8, FR-GEN-01 in the Path SRS) while sharing canonical CEFR skill measurements valid for 90 calendar days (D18, FR-START-03 in the Placement SRS), selecting a new certificate and clicking XEM TRƯỚC KHI CHUYỂN opens a confirmation modal that explicitly details three deterministic transitions before committing1. First, the modal confirms that the learner's existing LearningPath and LearnerTopicCapability matrix on the outgoing certificate (for example, TOEIC\_CAT) are preserved intact in the database and never deleted or reset (FR-GEN-01)3. Second, the modal queries PlacementSkillResults for any measured or reused\_from\_prior skill coordinates recorded within the preceding 90 calendar days (D18) and lists each skill required by the incoming certificate alongside its reuse status—for example, when switching from two-skill TOEIC\_CAT to four-skill IELTS, the modal displays "Nghe: B2 · 71 (đo ngày 10/10/2026 — còn hiệu lực, được giữ lại)" and "Đọc: B2 · 42 (đo ngày 10/10/2026 — còn hiệu lực, được giữ lại)" alongside "Nói: Chưa có dữ liệu — cần làm bài xếp lớp bổ sung" and "Viết: Chưa có dữ liệu — cần làm bài xếp lớp bổ sung"2. Third, upon confirmation, if an active LearningPath already exists for the target certificate, the application switches the active path\_id pointer and loads that path immediately; if no path exists on the new certificate, the application routes the learner to the Dashboard (SCR-DB-01) or Supplemental Placement Preflight (SCR-PL-01) to measure only the unmeasured skills2.

### **3.2 Placement Result Screen (SCR-PL-04) — The Centerpiece Specification**

#### **3.2.1 Purpose and Learner Question**

The Placement Result Screen (SCR-PL-04) is the analytical centerpiece of the product1. It answers the learner's primary diagnostic question—*"How good am I right now, why do my skills differ, and what is my starting point?"*—by translating the PlacementResultContract (overall\_cefr, overall\_band\_position, limiting\_skill, and up to four per-skill \[cefr\_level, band\_position\] vectors) into an honest, non-misleading signboard display1.  
![][image11]

#### **3.2.2 Solving the Five Core Design Challenges of the Placement Result Screen (§6.1 Q1–Q5 & §6.5 Q13)**

##### **1\. Unifying Four CEFR Levels Plus an Overall Without Reading as Four Unrelated Numbers (§6.1 Q1)**

If the interface rendered four separate square cards in a ![][image12] grid alongside a fifth "Overall" badge, the learner would perceive five disconnected numbers and inevitably attempt to average the four skills mentally—wondering why Listening B2, Reading B2, Writing B1, and Speaking A2 yield an Overall rating of A2 rather than B11. Under Decision D1 of the Placement SRS, averaging across modalities is prohibited because it conceals asymmetric profiles and misleads the candidate into believing their overall readiness is B1 when a single A2 skill will bottleneck their target certificate2. To make the relationship between the individual skills and the overall rating self-evident, SCR-PL-04 replaces disconnected cards with a **Unified Profile Signboard Matrix** housed inside a single 2px solid \#14181d outer frame divided into two visually tethered zones1.  
The top zone of the matrix is the **Overall Floor Placard**, a full-width horizontal header split 35% / 65% by a 2px solid \#14181d vertical rule1. The left cell displays the condensed uppercase signage label MỨC ĐỘ TỔNG QUÁT (THEO KỸ NĂNG THẤP NHẤT) above a prominent monospace coordinate badge (A2 · 64), paired with its read-only projected native certificate band (Tương đương IELTS 3.5) from the crosswalk lookup table2. The right cell displays a concise two-line diagnostic statement that explicitly names both the ceiling and the floor of the learner's profile ("Hồ sơ năng lực không đồng đều: Nghe và Đọc đã đạt B2, nhưng Nói đang ở A2 · 64\. Mức tổng quát được neo theo kỹ năng thấp nhất (Nói) vì lộ trình học cần ưu tiên bù đắp kỹ năng đang kéo điểm xuống.") alongside the single primary call-to-action button1. Directly below this header sits the **Aligned Six-Band Horizon Table**, where the examined skills (4 rows on TOEIC\_LR, IELTS, and VSTEP; 2 rows on TOEIC\_CAT and TOEIC\_SW per D4) are stacked vertically in a shared coordinate table so every row shares the exact same horizontal CEFR ordinate spanning Pre-A1 through C21. The row corresponding to overall\_result.limiting\_skill (such as NÓI) carries a left 6px solid \#f2b705 Sign Gold structural bar and an explicit tag \[KỸ NĂNG GIỚI HẠN MỨC TỔNG QUÁT\], visually tethering the weakest skill row to the Overall badge directly above it1. Simultaneously, a vertical 2px dashed \#0b4ea2 line cuts across all skill rows at the learner's declared Target Band (such as MỤC TIÊU: B2), enabling the learner to see in one vertical glance which skills have already crossed the target threshold and which skills require remediation1.

##### **2\. Presenting the 0–100 Intra-Band Position So Crossing a Band Never Reads as a Regression (§6.1 Q2)**

Under Decisions D12 and D13 of the Placement SRS, each skill carries a discrete CEFR band ![][image13] and a 0–100 integer ![][image14] representing relative position inside that band, derived from the continuous coordinate ![][image15] where ![][image16] indexes Pre-A1 through C22. For objective skills, ![][image17] combines mastery above the 70% threshold at band ![][image13] (70% weight) with progress toward 70% on band ![][image18] (30% weight); for productive skills, ![][image19] interpolates the composite rubric mean ![][image20] across the band's cut interval ![][image21]2. Because crossing a band boundary resets ![][image14] toward the bottom of the new, higher band, a candidate who advances from B2 · 78 (![][image22]) to C1 · 12 (![][image23]) experiences a \+0.34-band gain, yet if ![][image14] were rendered as an isolated 0–100% bar or standalone percentage, the learner would see 78% drop to 12% and misread progress as collapse1.  
The interface eliminates this regression illusion through three mandatory structural rules1. First, the % symbol is strictly prohibited on band\_position: the integer ![][image2] is never printed as 78% or 12%, but is formatted exclusively in monospace as an inseparable compound coordinate (B2 · 78 or C1 · 12\) paired with an explicit intra-band location phrase ("Đầu bậc C1 (vị trí 12/100 trong bậc C1)" for ![][image24], "Giữa bậc C1 (vị trí 50/100)" for ![][image25], and "Cuối bậc B2 (vị trí 78/100 — sát ngưỡng lên bậc C1)" for ![][image26])1. Second, the visual progress track in each skill row of SCR-PL-04 and on skill cards in SCR-DB-01 is never an isolated 0–100 bar representing a single band; instead, it is a **Six-Segment Stepped Horizon Bar** (A1 \| A2 \| B1 \| B2 \| C1 \| C2, with a narrow Pre-A1 origin notch) where each band occupies one equal segment (![][image27] of the track width) and the integer ![][image2] determines the marker's fractional horizontal offset *inside that band's segment*2. All bands below the awarded band ![][image13] are filled solid ink \#14181d, while the segment for band ![][image13] is filled \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue up to ![][image28] of its segment width1. Consequently, when a learner moves from B2 · 78 to C1 · 12, the filled bar visibly lengthens rightward across the B2 \| C1 vertical keyline into the C1 segment1. Third, whenever a retake or calibration comparison delta is displayed, the delta is evaluated on the continuous coordinate ![][image29] rather than ![][image30] alone: when ![][image31], the interface renders a \#0a6b3c Sign Green upward arrow SVG beside the text TĂNG BẬC: B2 (78/100) → C1 (12/100) \[Vượt ngưỡng B2 sang đầu bậc C1\], and never computes or prints ![][image32]1.

##### **3\. Progressive Rendering While Speaking and Writing Are Being Graded (§6.1 Q3 & U8, D5)**

Under Storage Mandate M1 and FR-GRADE-02 of the Placement SRS, PlacementSnapshotProjector writes PlacementSkillResults idempotently as each skill resolves2. Immediately upon submitting the productive half of placement, the candidate lands on SCR-PL-04 while PlacementTests.status \= 'in\_progress' and the Speaking and Writing rows have skill\_status \= 'grading' (D5, FR-REP-01)2. Rather than blocking behind a full-screen spinner, SCR-PL-04 renders a complete, immediately useful diagnostic view of the objective half while productive grading progresses in place1. The Listening and Reading rows immediately display their final cefr\_level · band\_position coordinates, their 6-segment horizon bars, their native certificate projections (IELTS / TOEIC / VSTEP), and their diagnostic topic signal breakdown (weak\_signal vs. on\_level\_signal from topic\_priors\[\])2. Directly below them, the Speaking and Writing rows render inside 2px solid \#14181d frames with a monospace status placard \[ĐANG CHẤM BẰNG AI\] and a live task-level counter driven by Server-Sent Events ("Bài 1/2: Đã chấm xong · Bài 2/2: Đang phân tích tiêu chí (ước tính 15–30 giây)...")2. While any examined skill remains in grading, the top Overall placard displays TẠM THỜI (ĐANG ĐỢI CHẤM NÓI & VIẾT): B2 · 42 with a caption explaining that B2 · 42 is the lower of the measured objective skills and that the final Overall rating will lock automatically as soon as Speaking and Writing resolve2. As each productive skill finishes grading, its row transitions in place from grading to measured without a page reload2.

##### **4\. Representing "This Skill Could Not Be Measured" vs. a Low Score or Single-Task Estimate (§6.1 Q4 & U11, D7, D17)**

The Placement SRS defines three distinct non-standard measurement outcomes that the interface must differentiate visually and verbally so that a technical failure or reduced task sample is never mistaken for low learner proficiency1. When both productive tasks in a skill fail AI grading after three exponential-backoff retries (unmeasured\_reason \= 'ai\_grading\_failed'), or when a sitting expires or submits with zero completed tasks in that skill (candidate\_skipped / inactivity\_timeout), the skill resolves to skill\_status \= 'not\_measured' (D7, D17)2. Per Decision U11, an unmeasured skill is **never** rendered as Pre-A1, A1, 0, or a greyed-out disabled row (because grey reads as the learner's fault and a bottom band is a fabricated score)1. Instead, the row renders as a **Sign Gold-bordered panel (border: 2px solid \#f2b705, background \#ffffff)** containing a drawn warning triangle SVG beside the uppercase placard CHƯA ĐO ĐƯỢC, an unplotted horizon track marked KHÔNG TÍNH VÀO MỨC TỔNG QUÁT (D17), a plain-language reason ("Hệ thống chấm tự động không xử lý được bản ghi âm/bài viết sau 3 lần thử. Kỹ năng này được tạm tách khỏi mức tổng quát."), and a 2px solid \#14181d button in \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue labeled CHẤM LẠI BÀI NÀY (if audio/text was captured in FreeResponses) or ĐO BỔ SUNG KỸ NĂNG NÀY (which launches a targeted 2-task sitting for that skill alone without triggering the 24-hour cooldown)1.  
In sharp contrast, a candidate who completes the tasks or stages and genuinely scores below the 70% A1 mastery threshold (D14) or below 0.75 on the productive rubric (2.md §4.2) receives skill\_status \= 'measured' and cefr\_level \= 'Pre-A1'2. That row renders inside a standard 2px solid \#14181d ink frame (never gold), prints the translated coordinate DƯỚI A1 (MỨC KHỞI ĐẦU) · VỊ TRÍ 45/100 (never the raw database key below\_A1), plots the marker inside the Pre-A1 origin notch on the horizon bar, and explains: "Đạt dưới 70% ở nhóm câu hỏi A1. Lộ trình của bạn sẽ bắt đầu từ các bài học nền tảng A1."1. Finally, when 1 of the 2 productive tasks grades successfully and the second task fails or is skipped (estimated\_from\_single\_task \= true, Decision D7), Generalizability Theory dependability drops from ![][image33] (![][image34] bands) to ![][image35] (![][image36] bands)2. In that state, the row displays the measured band and position paired with a \#f2b705 Sign Gold badge \[ƯỚC TÍNH TỪ 1/2 BÀI · ĐỘ TIN CẬY THẤP HƠN\] and the factual explanation: "Điểm kỹ năng này được tính từ 1 bài làm hoàn tất (bài thứ hai bị lỗi hoặc bỏ trống). Kết quả sẽ được hiệu chỉnh lại ở bước kiểm tra đầu tiên trên lộ trình."2.

##### **5\. The Single Call to Action at the End of Placement (§6.1 Q5)**

In accordance with the One-Action Rule (§4.3), the top-right action slot of SCR-PL-04 renders **exactly one primary \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue button (2px solid \#14181d frame)** rather than competing buttons to set a goal, browse lessons, or start free drilling1. The label and target route of this single CTA resolve deterministically from the learner's goal and sitting state1. If the learner has not yet configured their study objective (target\_band\_code, target\_exam\_date, weekly\_target\_hours), the single primary CTA reads THIẾT LẬP MỤC TIÊU & TẠO LỘ TRÌNH HỌC and opens SCR-LP-021. If the learner already established their goal parameters prior to sitting placement and at least one skill is measured, the path generator (FR-GEN-02, FR-GEN-04) automatically synthesizes the initial 4-week window in the background, and the single primary CTA reads XEM LỘ TRÌNH HỌC 4 TUẦN CỦA BẠN (routing directly to SCR-LP-01)1. While Speaking and Writing are still in skill\_status \= 'grading' (D5), this button reads XEM TRƯỚC LỘ TRÌNH NGHE & ĐỌC (ĐANG ĐỢI CHẤM NÓI/VIẾT) (2.md §6.2), allowing immediate inspection of the provisional objective schedule before productive grading finishes2. In the rare event that an upstream AI outage causes all examined skills to resolve to not\_measured (completion\_failure\_reason \= 'all\_examined\_skills\_unmeasured', D17), FR-START-01 waives the 24-hour cooldown and the single primary CTA reads THỬ CHẤM LẠI / LÀM LẠI NGAY (MIỄN THỜI GIAN CHỜ)2.

##### **6\. Transparency Footer & Reused/Aging Skill Indicator (§6.5 Q13, D14, D18, U12)**

At the bottom of the Unified Profile Signboard Matrix, a 1px solid \#ccd2d6 footer strip displays three mandatory provenance disclosures1. First, per Decision D14, it publishes the objective mastery rule in plain text: "Quy tắc xếp bậc Nghe & Đọc: Bạn được xếp vào bậc CEFR cao nhất mà tại đó (và tất cả các bậc thấp hơn) bạn trả lời đúng tối thiểu 70% số câu hỏi (5/7 câu)."2. Second, per Decision U12, beside Speaking and Writing scores it prints the compact monospace provenance label \[ĐIỂM DO AI ƯỚC TÍNH THEO RUBRIC 4 TIÊU CHÍ\] so the learner knows the score is AI-estimated without repeating a multi-sentence disclaimer across every panel1. Third, to answer **§6.5 Q13** (*"What shows the learner that a result is old — a placement result reused for up to 90 days?"*), every skill row prints its original measured\_at timestamp in monospace (Đo ngày: 04/11/2026)1. When a skill result was carried over from an earlier sitting via FR-START-03 (skill\_status \= 'reused\_from\_prior', D18), the row carries a bordered badge \[SỬ DỤNG LẠI KẾT QUẢ NGÀY 15/09/2026 · CÒN HIỆU LỰC 40 NGÀY\]1. Furthermore, whenever any skill measurement displayed on SCR-PL-04, SCR-DB-01, or SCR-LP-01 reaches 60 to 90 calendar days since its last calibration (last\_calibrated\_at or measured\_at), the timestamp badge shifts to \#f2b705 Sign Gold (\[ĐO CÁCH ĐÂY 72 NGÀY · HẾT HẠN SAU 18 NGÀY\]) alongside a secondary action link Đo lại kỹ năng này1.

### **3.3 Placement Preflight, Two-Half Sitting, and Recovery Screens (SCR-PL-01 to SCR-PL-03)**

#### **3.3.1 Placement Preflight & Skill Reuse Gate (SCR-PL-01)**

The Placement Preflight screen (SCR-PL-01) governs entry into the diagnostic instrument, answering what skills will be tested, whether recent measurements can be reused, whether an interrupted sitting can be resumed, and whether audio hardware is operational (FR-START-01 to FR-START-04)2. When the learner has valid measured or reused\_from\_prior skill coordinates recorded within the past 90 calendar days (D18, FR-START-03—for instance, after switching from TOEIC\_CAT to IELTS per U23), SCR-PL-01 renders a two-option radio signboard1. The default active option (inverted \#14181d ink block with white text) is GIỮ KẾT QUẢ CÒN HIỆU LỰC & CHỈ ĐO KỸ NĂNG CÒN THIẾU, which lists each reusable skill's cefr\_level · band\_position and original measured\_at date and states the reduced sitting duration (such as "Giữ Nghe (B2 · 71\) và Đọc (B2 · 42\) đo ngày 10/10/2026. Chỉ làm phần Nói & Viết (\~30 phút).")2. The second option is ĐO LẠI TOÀN BỘ KỸ NĂNG (\~60 PHÚT)2.  
If the learner previously closed their browser tab during an active sitting (FR-START-02, U14), SCR-PL-01 resolves the server-side ExamAttempts state against the 24-hour resume window (U14)1. When the interrupted attempt is less than 24 hours old, SCR-PL-01 presents the **Active Placement Resume Signboard** displaying the start timestamp, completed skills, the active stage (Phần 1 or Phần 2), and the count of synced responses (Đã lưu: 14/18 câu), pairing the primary \#0b4ea2 CTA TIẾP TỤC BÀI XẾP LỚP ĐANG DỞ with a secondary button HỦY BÀI ĐANG DỞ & LÀM MỚI (KHÔNG TÍNH THỜI GIAN CHỜ 24H)1. If an abandoned attempt with zero measured skills exceeded the 24-hour TTL (U14), SCR-PL-01 renders a \#f2b705 Sign Gold explanation banner stating: "Bài kiểm tra xếp lớp bắt đầu ngày 02/11/2026 đã bị hủy sau 24 giờ không hoạt động. Việc hủy bài không tính vào thời gian chờ 24 giờ — bạn có thể bắt đầu bài mới ngay lập tức."1. Conversely, if the learner completed a sitting within the last 24 hours (now() \< cooldown\_until per D8 and FR-START-01), the launch button locks and displays the exact monospace countdown remaining until retake eligibility ("Mở lại sau: 14 giờ 22 phút")2. Prior to serving the first item, SCR-PL-01 executes hardware preflight verification (FR-START-04), requiring the learner to play a 5-second audio test track for Listening and complete a 3-second microphone loopback check for Speaking2.

#### **3.3.2 Objective Half Sitting (SCR-PL-02) and Productive Half Sitting (SCR-PL-03)**

Per Decision U8, the placement sitting is partitioned into two distinct sitting screens—the Objective Half (SCR-PL-02) followed by the Productive Half (SCR-PL-03)—with an inter-half objective result checkpoint between them1. Both screens hide the global 6-item sidebar and render a 48px sitting header framed by a 2px solid \#14181d bottom keyline containing the active half and stage placard (PHẦN 1/2: TRẮC NGHIỆM — KỸ NĂNG NGHE · GIAI ĐOẠN 1/2), the optimistic local answered counter and sync status pill (FR-ANS-02: ĐÃ TRẢ LỜI: 07/08 · ĐÃ ĐỒNG BỘ in \#0a6b3c or ĐÃ TRẢ LỜI: 07/08 · 02 LƯU TẠI MÁY (CHỜ MẠNG) in \#f2b705), and a LƯU & THOÁT TẠM THỜI (GIỮ TIẾN ĐỘ 24H) control1. Per Decision D19, **no overall sitting countdown timer is rendered** so that placement measures language competence rather than test-taking speed2.  
In the Objective Half (SCR-PL-02), Listening and Reading execute the two-stage multistage adaptive testing (MST) blueprint (8 items in Stage 1 across A1–C2, routing to 10–12 boundary items in Stage 2 so every evaluated band totals ![][image37] items under the equalized blueprint or 6 \+ 10 items under the baseline blueprint per 2.md §5.1)2. During Listening (FR-SERVE-02), the top panel renders a non-scrubbable linear audio player (1 LƯỢT NGHE DUY NHẤT) that sequences a monospace 15s pre-audio reading countdown, single-play audio delivery, and a post-audio selection window; directly below the player, all child items attached to that shared audio track (2–4 items) are rendered simultaneously in chronological order of acoustic evidence (![][image38])2. During Reading (FR-SERVE-02), a split-pane layout renders the scrollable reading passage in the left 55% pane and the linked child items in the right 45% pane2. Under the Hybrid MST Navigation Policy (FR-SERVE-03), learners may freely navigate backward and forward across all items within the currently active stage (Stage 1 or Stage 2\) to correct mis-clicks—which empirical studies show reduces measurement error because wrong-to-right revisions outnumber right-to-wrong changes by 57% to 21% (Vispoel, 1998)—while item CEFR levels remain strictly hidden (U18)1. When the candidate clicks TIẾP TỤC SANG GIAI ĐOẠN 2 at the end of Stage 1, a confirmation modal warns that Stage 1 answers will lock permanently (FR-SERVE-03); confirming executes Stage 1 locking, Stage 1 cNC routing (FR-TRANS-02), and Stage 2 bundle activation in one atomic server transaction while transitioning the client inline (\<300ms skeleton labeled ĐANG TẢI GIAI ĐOẠN 2...) directly to Item 1 of Stage 2 with zero interim score display (FR-TRANS-01)2.  
Upon completing Reading Stage 2, the interface transitions to SCR-PL-03, opening first on the **Inter-Half Checkpoint Signboard (U8)**1. This panel reveals the candidate's immediate Listening (B2 · 71\) and Reading (B2 · 42\) bands, states that the Productive Half (2 Speaking tasks and 2 Writing tasks, \~30 minutes) has been anchored to their objective floor ![][image4] (FR-TRANS-03, D6), verifies microphone loopback, and presents the single primary CTA BẮT ĐẦU PHẦN 2 (NÓI & VIẾT)1. In the Speaking tasks (Task 1 transactional/descriptive S-DESC/S-INT at ![][image39]; Task 2 analytical/argumentative S-SYN/S-ARG at ![][image40]), the screen renders the prompt, a monospace preparation timer (30–60s), and a hard **60-second recording limit bar (00:60, D19)**2. If the browser reloads during an active Speaking recording, FR-ANS-03 discards the incomplete audio stream, increments reload\_retry\_count (0 \-\> 1), and displays a \#f2b705 Sign Gold notice granting **one full 60-second recovery retry** on that task (or swapping an unseen sibling task if a second reload occurs)2. In the Writing tasks (Task 1 W-CORR/W-DATA 60–140 words; Task 2 W-ARG/W-DISC 120–220 words), the screen provides a plain-text composition area with debounced auto-save every 2,000ms (FR-ANS-01) and a live monospace word counter; submitting Task 1 locks it immediately (FR-SERVE-03) and dispatches in-flight AI grading (FR-GRADE-01) while the candidate composes Task 22. If the candidate clicks NỘP BÀI XẾP LỚP with unanswered items or unsubmitted tasks, FR-SUB-01 presents an explicit confirmation modal enumerating the exact unanswered counts per section before finalizing submission2.

### **3.4 The Learner Dashboard (SCR-DB-01)**

#### **3.4.1 Purpose and Learner Question**

The Learner Dashboard (SCR-DB-01, route /home) ties diagnostic placement, weekly path execution, and per-skill standing into a single decision surface1. It answers: *"What is the single action I must take right now, how is my week's work going, and where does each skill stand relative to my target band?"*1.  
![][image41]

#### **3.4.2 Pre-Placement State: The Single-Block Dashboard (U13)**

When a learner has no completed placement result (PlacementTests has no done row for the active certificate and no reusable 90-day skill coordinates), Decision U13 strictly forbids rendering ghost skill cards, empty "—" placeholders, or locked dashboard panels, because a new learner encountering a grid of empty figures reads a broken product at the exact moment they have no reason to trust it1. Instead, SCR-DB-01 renders **exactly one centered signboard panel (width: 680px, border: 2px solid \#14181d, background \#ffffff)** on the \#eef0f1 wall canvas1. This panel carries the uppercase header BƯỚC KHỞI ĐẦU: KIỂM TRA XẾP LỚP ĐẦU VÀO, followed by a single factual paragraph explaining what placement measures and how long it takes, dynamically matched to the active certificate's examined skills (D4): for 4-skill certificates (IELTS, TOEIC\_LR, VSTEP), it states that placement measures Listening, Reading, Speaking, and Writing on the CEFR scale (A1–C2) across two untimed halves in approximately 60 minutes free of charge; for 2-skill certificates (TOEIC\_CAT or TOEIC\_SW), it names the exact two examined skills and states the \~30 minute duration1. Below the copy sits a single \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue button (2px solid \#14181d frame): BẮT ĐẦU BÀI KIỂM TRA XẾP LỚP (MIỄN PHÍ) (or TIẾP TỤC BÀI XẾP LỚP ĐANG DỞ if an in\_progress sitting less than 24 hours old exists per U14)1.

#### **3.4.3 Post-Placement State: Enforcing the Three-Block Constraint and Coexisting Progress Axes (U5 & §6.2 Q1)**

Once placement completes, SCR-DB-01 is strictly locked at **three structural blocks (U5)**: **Block 1 (Next Action & Weekly Execution Signboard)**, **Block 2 (Goal Standing & Feasibility Ledger)**, and **Block 3 (Per-Skill Standing Matrix)**1. The legacy dashboard was cut from eleven blocks to three because eleven blocks hid the one action that mattered; any design that adds a fourth block is a regression1.  
To answer **§6.2 Q1** (*"How do 'this week' and 'distance to target' coexist inside three blocks without becoming two competing progress bars?"*), the interface enforces a strict **Visual Encoding Separation Rule** grounded in FR-PROG-01 through FR-PROG-03 of the Path SRS1. Because "This Week's Work" (FR-PROG-02) is a small discrete count of scheduled activities (![][image42] steps) and study minutes, it lives exclusively inside **Block 1 (Next Action Signboard)** as a **Discrete Segmented Step Tally** rather than a percentage bar1. Specifically, the right compartment of Block 1 renders ![][image43] adjacent 24×24px square check-boxes framed in 2px solid \#14181d (where closed steps invert to solid \#14181d ink blocks with a white check SVG, the active step carries a \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue frame, and remaining steps are \#ffffff painted fields), accompanied by the monospace ratio TIẾN ĐỘ TUẦN 03: 04/06 BƯỚC (110 / 165 PHÚT) and the Free Drilling gate tag (\[LUYỆN TỰ DO: MỞ SAU 02 BƯỚC NỮA\] or \[LUYỆN TỰ DO: ĐÃ MỞ\] in \#0a6b3c)1.  
Conversely, macro schedule standing (FR-PROG-03) lives inside **Block 2 (Goal Standing Ledger)** as a **Tabular Numeric Ledger with Zero Progress Bars**1. Block 2 is a compact 64px-high horizontal signboard divided by 1px solid \#ccd2d6 vertical rules into four tabular cells: Cell 1 displays the current Overall Floor (MỨC HIỆN TẠI (THẤP NHẤT): A2 · 64 (NÓI)); Cell 2 displays the Target Band and Exam Date (MỤC TIÊU: B2 (IELTS 6.5) · NGÀY THI: 15/03/2027, shifting to a \#f2b705 Sign Gold countdown when ![][image10] days remain per U22); Cell 3 displays the cumulative Guided Learning Hours distance across all examined skills computed by FeasibilityCalculator (KHOẢNG CÁCH TỚI MỤC TIÊU: \~315 GIỜ HỌC CÓ HƯỚNG DẪN); and Cell 4 displays the deterministic feasibility verdict badge (\[TIẾN ĐỘ: KHẢ THI · 2.75 GIỜ/TUẦN\] in \#0a6b3c Sign Green, \[TIẾN ĐỘ: CẦN CỐ GẮNG (STRETCH)\] in \#f2b705 Sign Gold, or \[TIẾN ĐỘ: QUÁ TẢI — CẦN ĐIỀU CHỈNH MỤC TIÊU\] in \#b31217 Sign Red)1. Finally, psychometric band distance per skill lives exclusively inside **Block 3 (Per-Skill Standing Matrix)**, where each skill card renders its cefr\_level · band\_position coordinate, its **Six-Segment Stepped Horizon Bar** (A1..C2) against the vertical dashed Target Band line, and its weekly step allocation (Ba bước tuần này · 85 phút)1. Because Block 1 uses discrete check-boxes, Block 2 uses a bar-free numeric ledger, and Block 3 uses per-skill CEFR horizon tracks, "this week" and "distance to target" never compete as two ambiguous percentage bars1.

#### **3.4.4 Deterministic Selection of the Single Next Action in Block 1 (§6.2 Q2)**

Block 1 (Hero Action Signboard) contains **exactly one primary \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue CTA button**1. When a learner has four distinct skill levels, an active weekly plan, and a gated free-drilling mode, the interface resolves which single action occupies Block 1 through a deterministic seven-tier priority cascade backed by the Placement and Path state machines (FR-START-02, FR-STEP-01, FR-SCHED-02, FR-SCHED-03, FR-DRILL-01, FR-DRILL-03, FR-END-01A..D)1. Crucially, the UI never invents its own ad-hoc skill selector on the dashboard because the Path scheduler (FR-SCHED-02 and FR-SCHED-03) has already weighted the weekly steps toward the weakest skill (![][image44]) and interleaved them in pedagogical **Increasing Practice** order (concept\_lesson ![][image3] blocked focus\_practice ![][image3] interleaved review\_spaced) along the unified timeline3.

| Priority Rank | Condition Evaluated Against Backend State | Block 1 Headline & Context Displayed | Single Primary CTA Label & Target Route |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Priority 1** | Active placement sitting (in\_progress ![][image45]) OR completed placement with 0 goal parameters set. | Names the unfinished placement stage (FR-START-02) or prompts initial goal setup after placement (FR-GEN-02). | TIẾP TỤC BÀI XẾP LỚP ĐANG DỞ (/placement/sitting) OR THIẾT LẬP MỤC TIÊU & TẠO LỘ TRÌNH (/path/goal) |
| **Priority 2** | Any examined skill has skill\_status \= 'not\_measured' due to ai\_grading\_failed (U11, D17). | Highlights that a skill could not be graded during placement and can be retried immediately. | CHẤM LẠI / ĐO BỔ SUNG KỸ NĂNG \[TÊN KỸ NĂNG\] (/placement/results/:id) |
| **Priority 3** | Active LearningPath is in a terminal state (exam\_date\_arrived, target\_reached, stagnated, abandoned per FR-END-01A..D). | Displays the terminal state summary sentence (e.g., exam date reached or plateau detected). | XEM ĐÁNH GIÁ MỨC ĐỘ SẴN SÀNG THI (/path/readiness) OR KHÔI PHỤC LỘ TRÌNH HỌC (/path) |
| **Priority 4** | A PathStep in active week ![][image46] is currently status \= 'in\_progress' (FR-STEP-04 partial step saved). | Displays the partially completed step's skill, topic, level, and saved item index (Đã làm 04/10 câu). | TIẾP TỤC BƯỚC ĐANG LÀM: \[KỸ NĂNG — CHỦ ĐỀ\] (/practice/session/:id) |
| **Priority 5** | Active week ![][image46] has ![][image5] status \= 'available' PathStep (where the planner has already interleaved skills and weighted the weakest skill via FR-SCHED-02 & FR-SCHED-03). | Displays the lowest-sequence\_order available step in ![][image46], its skill (Nói), topic (S-ARG), level (Bậc A2), step size (1 bài ghi âm · \~15 phút), and "ÔN LẠI" badge if is\_repeat\_attempt \= true (U20). | BẮT ĐẦU BƯỚC \[X/Y\]: \[LOẠI BƯỚC — KỸ NĂNG\] (/practice/... or /path/steps/:id/lesson) |
| **Priority 6** | All scheduled steps in ![][image46] are status \= 'closed' (free\_drill\_unlocked \= true per L6 / FR-DRILL-01), and daily cognitive cap (FR-DRILL-06) is not reached. | States that all scheduled steps for Week ![][image47] are complete (06/06 bước) and Free Drilling is open, highlighting the \#1 recommended (skill, topic\_id, target\_cefr) tuple (FR-DRILL-03) from the limiting skill. | LUYỆN TỰ DO ĐỀ XUẤT: \[KỸ NĂNG — CHỦ ĐỀ · BẬC L\] (/practice) |
| **Priority 7** | All steps in ![][image46] are closed AND the learner has hit the daily Free Drilling cap (FR-DRILL-06). | States that both the weekly schedule and today's memory-consolidation practice limit are complete (FR-DRILL-06). | XEM LẠI BÀI HỌC & GIẢI THÍCH ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH (/path) |

#### **3.4.5 Dashboard Adaptation for Two-Skill Certificates (§6.2 Q3)**

For certificates that examine only two skills (TOEIC\_CAT: Listening and Reading; TOEIC\_SW: Speaking and Writing), SCR-DB-01 must never render a 4-card grid with two empty cards or two cards labeled "Không áp dụng" (§6.2 Q3)1. Instead, Block 3's CSS Grid container binds its column template directly to examined\_skills.length (D4, FR-START-03)2. When examined\_skills.length \=== 4 (IELTS, TOEIC\_LR, VSTEP), Block 3 renders a **4-column keylined grid** (grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr), each card \~290px wide)1. When examined\_skills.length \=== 2 (TOEIC\_CAT, TOEIC\_SW), Block 3 renders a **2-column keylined grid** (grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr), each card \~590px wide)1. Because each card in the 2-skill layout spans half the dashboard width, it utilizes the horizontal space to display the top three priority topic capability rows (LearnerTopicCapability: such as L-INF, L-DET, and L-ATT on TOEIC\_CAT, or the four analytical rubric criteria c1..c4 from LearnerSkillState.criterion\_profile on TOEIC\_SW) inline inside each skill card without introducing a fourth dashboard block2.

### **3.5 The Learning Path View, Goal Calibration, and Terminal Verdicts (SCR-LP-01, SCR-LP-02, SCR-LP-03)**

#### **3.5.1 Communicating "On Track" in a Plan With No Fixed End (SCR-LP-01 — Answering §6.3 Q4)**

Because the rebuilt path engine operates as a **sliding four-week window (W\_1, W\_2, W\_3, W\_4 per P1, FR-GEN-04, FR-GEN-05)** that synthesizes Week ![][image48] into slot ![][image49] whenever ![][image46] closes, there is no fixed total step denominator and no "Bước 9/20" counter (§6.3 Q4)1. To communicate whether the learner is on track without a fixed step count, SCR-LP-01 anchors the top of /path with a **Two-Tier Trajectory Signboard** (border: 2px solid \#14181d, background \#ffffff)1.  
The top tier is the **Dual-Progress Telemetry Header (FR-PROG-01 to FR-PROG-03)**, divided into two equal 50% compartments by a 2px solid \#14181d vertical rule1. The left compartment renders **Axis 1 (This Week's Execution — FR-PROG-02)**, showing the active week sequence number and date span (TUẦN HỌC THỨ 03 · 04/11 – 10/11/2026), the discrete segmented step tally (04/06 BƯỚC HOÀN THÀNH · 110/165 PHÚT), and the status of the L6 Free Drilling gate (\[LUYỆN TỰ DO: CÒN 02 BƯỚC ĐỂ MỞ\])3. The right compartment renders **Axis 2 (Distance to Target Band & Pacing Velocity — FR-PROG-03)**, displaying the per-skill CEFR coordinates against the target band, the remaining Guided Learning Hours integral across skills (CÒN \~315 GIỜ HỌC CÓ HƯỚNG DẪN TỚI MỤC TIÊU B2), and the pacing comparison (Tốc độ yêu cầu: 2.5 giờ/tuần · Cam kết của bạn: 2.75 giờ/tuần), topped by the explicit trajectory badge: \[ĐÚNG TIẾN ĐỘ TỚI NGÀY THI 15/03/2027\] (feasible in \#0a6b3c Sign Green), \[TIẾN ĐỘ SÁT NÚT — CẦN DUY TRÌ ĐỦ GIỜ\] (stretch in \#f2b705 Sign Gold), or \[CHẬM TIẾN ĐỘ — CẦN ĐIỀU CHỈNH MỤC TIÊU\] (unrealistic in \#b31217 Sign Red)3. Directly beneath this header sits the **Sliding 4-Week Window Selector Strip (FR-GEN-04, FR-GEN-05)**, a horizontal 5-tab bar framed in 2px solid \#14181d containing an expandable archive drawer tab (\[LỊCH SỬ ĐÃ QUA (02 TUẦN)\] for historical weeks where window\_slot \= NULL), the inverted \#14181d active tab (TUẦN HIỆN TẠI: TUẦN 03 · 04/06 BƯỚC in slot ![][image46]), and the three buffered future tabs (TUẦN 04, TUẦN 05, and TUẦN 06 in slots ![][image50]), accompanied by the explanatory line: "Lộ trình luôn mở trước 4 tuần tiếp theo và tự động cuốn chiếu thêm tuần mới khi bạn hoàn thành tuần hiện tại."1.

#### **3.5.2 Presenting Variable Step Size and Repeated Steps Before Starting (§6.3 Q5 & U20)**

Within the active week (![][image46]) timeline, steps are rendered as a vertical sequence of full-width rectangular signboard rows (border: 2px solid \#14181d, separated by 12px of \#eef0f1 wall canvas)1. Because a step's size varies dynamically from a 5-item maintenance check to a 2-module lesson plus 15 remedial items (FR-STEP-05), every step card renders a **Four-Column Metadata Placard** so the learner understands the exact scope and reason for the step's size before clicking start (§6.3 Q5)1. Column 1 prints the step sequence index (BƯỚC 05/06), the drawn skill SVG icon beside the uppercase skill name (VIẾT), and the Decoupled Per-Skill CEFR target badge (BẬC B1, anchored strictly to that skill's current CEFR rating per §2.2 of the Path SRS, never to overall\_cefr)3. Column 2 prints the canonical topic code and Vietnamese name (W-ARG · Nghị luận bảo vệ quan điểm) alongside the pedagogical step type (FR-SCHED-03: BÀI HỌC CHIẾN LƯỢC, LUYỆN TẬP TRỌNG TÂM, ÔN TẬP NGẮT QUÃNG, or KIỂM TRA ĐỊNH KỲ THEO PHẦN)3. Column 3 explicitly prints the sizing\_tier badge (FR-STEP-05) and the exact monospace item and minute count: short\_maintenance steps (mastery\_band \= 'mastered') display \[DUY TRÌ KỸ NĂNG ĐÃ VỮNG\] · 05 CÂU TRẮC NGHIỆM · \~06 PHÚT; standard steps (developing / unmeasured) display \[LUYỆN TẬP TIÊU CHUẨN\] · 10 CÂU TRẮC NGHIỆM · \~14 PHÚT (or 01 BÀI HỌC \+ 04 CÂU ÁP DỤNG · \~15 PHÚT, or 01 BÀI VIẾT · \~15 PHÚT); and expanded\_remedial steps (low mastery) display \[CỦNG CỐ CHUYÊN SÂU — CHỦ ĐỀ ĐANG YẾU\] · 02 PHẦN BÀI HỌC \+ 15 CÂU LUYỆN TẬP · \~25 PHÚT (or 02 BÀI NÓI · \~20 PHÚT)3.  
Column 4 implements the **Repeat Step "ÔN LẠI" Contract (U20 & FR-STEP-06)**1. When a closed step records improvement\_status \= 'no\_improvement' and is\_repeat\_attempt \= false, FR-STEP-06 schedules exactly one repeat step (is\_repeat\_attempt \= true, sizing\_tier \= 'expanded\_remedial' with unseen items from the same cell)3. Because "Repeat" without a concrete target reads as punishment (U20), the repeated step card carries a 6px solid \#f2b705 Sign Gold left bar, the uppercase placard \[ÔN LẠI — LẦN 1/1\], and a mandatory monospace comparison block stating the prior score and the exact threshold needed (FR-STEP-03): for objective steps, it prints "Lần trước: 05/10 câu (50%) · Mục tiêu lượt ôn lại: Đạt tối thiểu 12/15 câu (80%) hoặc nâng xác suất thành thạo từ 0.42 lên \>0.52 (sử dụng bộ câu hỏi mới)"; for productive steps, it prints "Lần trước: Tiêu chí Ngữ pháp (W\_GR) đạt 2.5/6.0 · Mục tiêu lượt ôn lại: Đạt ≥3.0/6.0 ở tiêu chí W\_GR"1. If that repeated step closes a second time with no\_improvement (E2, FR-STEP-06), the engine never repeats it a third time; instead, the topic cell receives the persistent badge \[ĐIỂM YẾU CẦN HẠ BẬC ĐỆM\] (is\_weak\_spot \= true) and triggers a WEAK\_SPOT\_ESCALATED re-plan that pauses direct drills at level ![][image13] for one week and inserts a foundational bridge step at ![][image51] (FR-REPLAN-02)3.

#### **3.5.3 Presenting Event-Driven Re-Planning and Content Substitutions (§6.3 Q6, FR-REPLAN-03, P6)**

Because silent plan mutations destroy learner trust (§2.6, FR-REPLAN-03), re-planning executes exclusively on the four deterministic events defined in FR-REPLAN-01: MISSED\_TWO\_WEEKS (two consecutive weeks close with zero completed steps), SKILL\_CEFR\_CHANGED (a mock\_section sitting or placement retake shifts a skill's discrete CEFR level), USER\_FIT\_ADJUSTMENT (the learner edits weekly\_target\_hours, target\_exam\_date, or target\_band\_code), or WEAK\_SPOT\_ESCALATED (E2 repeat failure)1. Whenever a re-plan fires, SCR-LP-01 renders a non-modal, dismissible **Plan Adjustment Summary Signboard (BẢNG THÔNG BÁO ĐIỀU CHỈNH LỘ TRÌNH)** framed in 2px solid \#14181d with a \#f2b705 Sign Gold header strip directly above Week ![][image46] (§6.3 Q6, FR-REPLAN-03)1. This signboard states the exact trigger event and timestamp, confirms the immutability boundary (FR-REPLAN-02: "Tất cả các bước bạn đã hoàn thành (04 bước trong Tuần 03\) được giữ nguyên tuyệt đối. Chỉ các bước chưa bắt đầu từ cuối Tuần 03 đến Tuần 06 được sắp xếp lại."), presents a two-column monospace **Before-and-After Diff Table** comparing the old and new weekly step allocations and levels (for example, showing that Đọc R-INF Bậc B2 was temporarily replaced in Week 3 by a foundational bridge step Đọc R-INF Bậc B1 (10 câu) before resuming B2 in Week 5), and displays the refreshed FeasibilityCalculator badge alongside an acknowledgment button ĐÃ HIỂU & ĐÓNG THÔNG BÁO3.  
Similarly, in accordance with Principle P6 (*"when content is missing, substitute and say so—never refuse to generate; never schedule a step that cannot be completed"*), whenever a step invokes the four-tier **Content Substitution Cascade (BR-POOL-01)** or **Missing Lesson Substitution (BR-POOL-02)** because unseen items in (topic\_id, target\_cefr) were exhausted or inside the 24-hour wrong-answer cooldown (BR-COOL-01), both the step card on SCR-LP-01 and the session header on SCR-PRAC-04/SCR-LS-01 display a 1px solid \#14181d disclosure strip stating the exact substitution applied—for example, "Thông báo thay thế nội dung (Bậc 2): Bạn đã hoàn thành hết câu hỏi mới của chủ đề R-DET ở bậc B2. Hệ thống bổ sung 03 câu hỏi từ chủ đề tương đương R-INF (cùng bậc B2) để đảm bảo tiến độ học."3.

#### **3.5.4 Displaying Skill Allocation Skew and Two-Skill Certificates on the Path (§6.3 Q7 & Q8)**

To answer **§6.3 Q7** (*"How are steps assigned to skills shown, given the plan skews toward weak skills? Does the learner see 'this week: 3 Reading, 1 Listening, 1 Writing'?"*), the header of each week tab (![][image52]) on SCR-LP-01 renders a dedicated **Weekly Skill Allocation Strip (PHÂN BỔ KỸ NĂNG TRONG TUẦN)** directly above the step cards1. Using the exact priority weights from FR-SCHED-02 (![][image44], where ![][image53]), this strip displays a single segmented horizontal bar partitioned by skill alongside the explicit monospace step count, minute allocation, and rationale for every examined skill: PHÂN BỔ TUẦN 03 (06 BƯỚC · 165 PHÚT): NÓI: 03 BƯỚC (85 PHÚT · 52% — Ưu tiên kỹ năng giới hạn A2→B2) \| VIẾT: 01 BƯỚC (40 PHÚT · 24% — B1→B2) \| ĐỌC: 01 BƯỚC (25 PHÚT · 15% — Sát mục tiêu B2) \| NGHE: 01 BƯỚC (15 PHÚT · 9% — Duy trì B2 đã đạt)1. Because the step cards below the strip are interleaved across skills (FR-SCHED-03: ![][image54]) so the learner does not grind three Speaking steps consecutively, the Weekly Skill Allocation Strip makes the macro skew toward weak skills immediately transparent while preserving the interleaved execution order of the timeline3.  
To answer **§6.3 Q8** (*"What does the learning path show for a certificate with two skills?"*), when the active certificate is TOEIC\_CAT (![][image55]) or TOEIC\_SW (![][image56]), FR-SCHED-02 normalizes ![][image57] strictly across the two active modalities3. On SCR-LP-01, the Weekly Skill Allocation Strip renders only those two skills (for example, on TOEIC\_CAT where Reading is B1 · 40 and Listening is B2 · 20 toward a B2 target: ĐỌC: 04 BƯỚC (110 PHÚT · 68% — Ưu tiên bù đắp B1→B2) \| NGHE: 02 BƯỚC (55 PHÚT · 32% — Củng cố B2)), and the timeline interleaves steps strictly between the two active modalities (Đọc → Nghe → Đọc → Nghe) with zero filter tabs, badges, or placeholders for unexamined skills1.

#### **3.5.5 Terminal Path States and the Exam Readiness Verdict (SCR-LP-03 — FR-END-01A..D, FR-END-02)**

The learning path supports all four terminal end states mandated by P7 and FR-END-01A..D3. When every examined skill achieves ![][image58] verified by a mock\_section sitting prior to target\_exam\_date (target\_reached, FR-END-01A), SCR-LP-03 renders a \#0a6b3c Sign Green **Readiness Verdict Signboard (ĐÃ ĐẠT MỤC TIÊU TRƯỚC NGÀY THI)** confirming each skill's verified coordinate and offering a one-click toggle into **Peak Maintenance Mode** (scheduling lightweight 5-item maintenance checks and weekly mock sections until exam day) or raising target\_band\_code3. When the calendar reaches target\_exam\_date (exam\_date\_arrived, FR-END-01B & FR-END-02), SCR-LP-03 invokes FeasibilityCalculator (E3) to classify the learner into one of four deterministic verdicts: SẴN SÀNG THI (READY) (![][image59] and all skills at target), SÁT NGƯỠNG MỤC TIÊU (BORDERLINE) (![][image60] and maximum skill gap ![][image61] bands), CHƯA ĐỦ ĐIỀU KIỆN ĐẠT MỤC TIÊU (NOT YET READY) (![][image62] or any skill lagging by ![][image63] bands), or CHƯA ĐỦ DỮ LIỆU ĐÁNH GIÁ GIỜ HỌC (CANNOT JUDGE)3. When the verdict is BORDERLINE or NOT YET READY, SCR-LP-03 displays an exact per-skill deficit table identifying which skills met target and how many guided hours the limiting skills still require, paired directly with a **Continue Preparation Flow** that pre-calculates the minimum feasible new exam date (![][image64]) and slides the 4-week window forward without losing any capability state3.  
For the remaining two terminal states (FR-END-01C and FR-END-01D), SCR-LP-01 renders a concise state badge plus a single diagnostic sentence and recovery action (P7)3. When two consecutive 4-week cycles elapse with ![][image65] across lagging skills despite ![][image66] step completion (stagnated, FR-END-01C), the header displays the \#f2b705 Sign Gold badge \[CHỮNG ĐIỂM — CẦN ĐIỀU CHỈNH BẬC HỌC\] and the sentence: "Các bước học trong 2 chu kỳ gần đây chưa làm tăng vị trí điểm ở kỹ năng giới hạn. Bạn nên lùi 01 tiểu bậc để củng cố nền tảng hoặc làm lại bài xếp lớp để định vị lại." paired with the button ĐIỀU CHỈNH BẬC HỌC & TÁI LẬP LỘ TRÌNH3. When four consecutive weeks pass with zero completed steps (abandoned, FR-END-01D), the header displays the neutral ink-bordered badge \[LỘ TRÌNH ĐANG TẠM DỪNG SAU 4 TUẦN KHÔNG HOẠT ĐỘNG\] and the sentence: "Lộ trình học đã được tạm dừng sau 4 tuần không có bước hoàn thành. Toàn bộ dữ liệu năng lực của bạn được bảo lưu — nhấn Khôi phục để cập nhật lại lịch học 4 tuần tiếp theo." paired with KHÔI PHỤC LỘ TRÌNH HỌC3.

### **3.6 Practice Hub, Free Drilling Gate, and Modality-Specific Session Viewports (SCR-PRAC-01 to SCR-PRAC-05, SCR-LS-01)**

#### **3.6.1 Presenting the Two Entry Points and the Free Drilling Gate (SCR-PRAC-01 to SCR-PRAC-03 — Answering §6.4 Q9 & Q10)**

Because learners can practice either by executing a **scheduled step from the active week's plan (![][image46])** or by launching **standalone Free Drilling** (L1, L6), and because FR-DRILL-01 (L6) locks Free Drilling until all scheduled steps in ![][image46] reach status \= 'closed', the Practice Hubs (SCR-PRAC-01 for Listening/Reading, SCR-PRAC-02 for Writing, and SCR-PRAC-03 for Speaking) must present both entry points on a single screen so the learner understands which door to use and why the second door is either closed or open (§6.4 Q9)1. Each Practice Hub is partitioned into **two stacked horizontal signboard zones (2px solid \#14181d)**1. Top Zone A (Scheduled Path Step Entry Point) is always open during an active week: it displays the next available PathStep in ![][image46] alongside the discrete ![][image46] step tally (TIẾN ĐỘ TUẦN 03: ĐÃ XONG 04/06 BƯỚC — CÒN 02 BƯỚC ĐỂ MỞ LUYỆN TỰ DO) and the single primary \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue CTA LÀM BƯỚC TRÊN LỘ TRÌNH NGAY: \[CHỦ ĐỀ · BẬC L · SỐ CÂU\]1.  
Bottom Zone B (Free Drilling Topic Matrix) houses standalone practice across the 20 canonical language topics crossed with the 6 CEFR bands (120 capability cells per certificate, 3.md §2.3)3. To answer **§6.4 Q10** (*"What does a locked free-drilling mode show, and does it motivate or annoy?"*), when free\_drill\_unlocked \= false, Zone B is **never hidden and never obscured behind an opaque lock screen**—because hiding the matrix or blocking inspection annoys the learner and conceals what the product offers1. Instead, Zone B renders the complete topic capability matrix in full high-contrast read-only preview (\#ffffff painted cells showing the learner's current mastery probability ![][image8], mastery band badge ĐÃ VỮNG / ĐANG PHÁT TRIỂN / CẦN CỦNG CỐ, and the 3 "Recommended This Week" tags per FR-DRILL-03, with only the launch buttons replaced by static \[KHÓA TỚI KHI XONG TUẦN 03\] tags), topped by a 2px solid \#14181d Gate Banner with a 6px solid \#f2b705 Sign Gold left bar stating: "CHẾ ĐỘ LUYỆN TỰ DO MỞ KHI HOÀN THÀNH CÁC BƯỚC TRONG TUẦN: Bạn đã làm 04/06 bước của Tuần 03\. Hoàn thành 02 bước còn lại ở khung phía trên (\~25 phút) để mở khóa toàn bộ ngân hàng luyện tự do (10 câu/lượt) cho phần còn lại của tuần."1. By letting the learner inspect their topic matrix and see the exact small remaining workload (02 bước · \~25 phút) required to unlock free choice, plus the explicit rule (BR-RECON-01) that mastering a topic in Free Drilling shrinks future path steps from 10–15 items down to 5-item maintenance checks (L7), the gate motivates completion of ![][image46] rather than provoking frustration1. The instant the final step in ![][image46] closes (FR-DRILL-01), the Gate Banner shifts to \#0a6b3c Sign Green (\[ĐÃ MỞ KHÓA LUYỆN TỰ DO ĐẾN HẾT CHỦ NHẬT 10/11/2026\]), activates the **Top 3 Recommended Drills Rail (ĐỀ XUẤT LUYỆN THÊM TRONG TUẦN per FR-DRILL-03)**, and enables all BẮT ĐẦU LUYỆN (10 CÂU) / BẮT ĐẦU LUYỆN (01 BÀI) buttons (FR-DRILL-04)3.

#### **3.6.2 Resting Topics (U19) and Daily Cognitive Ceiling (FR-DRILL-06)**

Within the Free Drilling topic matrix, two temporal spacing rules protect long-term retention and prevent item pool exhaustion (BR-COOL-01, FR-DRILL-06)1. Per Decision U19, whenever a (topic\_id, cefr\_level) cell is resting—either because its unseen items are inside the 24-hour wrong-answer cooldown (LearnerItemExposure.cooldown\_until \> NOW(), BR-COOL-01) or because the learner already completed today's 10-item free drill in that cell (OQ-03)—the topic row remains visible in its exact matrix position, dimmed via an \#eef0f1 background fill and \#5c6570 muted text (U19), with its action button replaced by a monospace timestamp converted strictly to the learner's local browser timezone (\[NGHỈ TỚI 09:00 MAI (05/11)\], never UTC) and the caption "Giãn cách 24 giờ giúp củng cố trí nhớ dài hạn."1. Furthermore, when a learner reaches the daily cognitive ceiling of 40 objective items (4 free-drill sessions) or 4 productive tasks in a skill within a single day (FR-DRILL-06), the skill's Free Drilling buttons lock until midnight with a \#f2b705 Sign Gold notice explaining that overnight consolidation is required and inviting the learner to review completed lessons or explanations3.

#### **3.6.3 How Practice Sessions Differ by Skill and How Much Is Visible at Once (SCR-PRAC-04, SCR-PRAC-05 — Answering §6.4 Q11 & Q12)**

Because Listening, Reading, Speaking, and Writing require fundamentally different cognitive operations (§2.5), the interface rejects a one-size-fits-all quiz wrapper and implements **three distinct modality-specific session architectures** across SCR-PRAC-04 (Objective) and SCR-PRAC-05 (Productive) (§6.4 Q11, Q12)1.  
![][image67]

### **3.7 Mock Exam Catalogue, Sitting, and Result View (SCR-EX-01 to SCR-EX-03)**

Per Decision U21, the Mock Exam Result Screen (SCR-EX-03) preserves its existing structural layout because a mock exam is a fundamentally different measurement—evaluating one specific timed paper on a native scaled score (such as TOEIC 785/990 or IELTS 6.5)—from the multi-stage adaptive placement coordinate (U21)1. Merging the mock-exam result screen with the placement result screen would leave the learner unable to distinguish a single paper's performance from their underlying proficiency coordinate1. On SCR-EX-03, only the band presentation changes: legacy DifficultyLevel 1–5 integers on section summaries and item review tables are deleted and replaced by canonical CEFR badges (A1–C2, D2, U21)1. When a path-scheduled mock\_section sitting (FR-SCHED-03) or full mock exam shifts a learner's discrete skill CEFR level upward or downward in LearnerSkillState (SKILL\_CEFR\_CHANGED trigger in FR-REPLAN-01), SCR-EX-03 renders a 2px solid \#14181d notice at the top of the result summary ("Kết quả phần thi này đã cập nhật mức năng lực Đọc của bạn từ B1 lên B2 · 18\. Lộ trình học 4 tuần đã được tự động điều chỉnh theo mức mới.") accompanied by a button linking directly to SCR-LP-013.

## **4\. Cross-Cutting Interaction Patterns Defined Once**

### **4.1 Progress Display Taxonomy (§6.6 Q16)**

The legacy product rendered four different kinds of progress—band standing, weekly completion, session progress, and topic mastery—using interchangeable, conflicting progress bars1. To eliminate visual ambiguity across all rebuilt screens, the interface enforces a strict **Four-Part Progress Display Taxonomy** (§6.6 Q16) where each underlying mathematical construct maps to exactly one visual encoding1.

| Progress Construct | Mathematical Domain & Grain | Mandatory Visual Representation | Screens Where Used & Prohibited Alternatives |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **1\. Proficiency Band Standing (theta\_CEFR)** | Continuous coordinate ![][image69] decomposed into discrete band ![][image70] \+ integer position ![][image2] (D12, D13). | **Six-Segment Stepped Horizon Bar (A1..C2) \+ Monospace Compound Coordinate (B2 · 71\)**: Lower bands filled \#14181d ink; active band filled \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue to ![][image28] of its segment width; vertical dashed line at Target Band. | Used on SCR-PL-04, SCR-DB-01 (Block 3), SCR-LP-01 header. **Prohibited**: Never render ![][image14] as an isolated 0–100% bar or with a % sign1. |
| **2\. Weekly Plan Completion (W\_1 Execution)** | Small discrete integer ratio ![][image71] steps \+ cumulative minutes (FR-PROG-02). | **Discrete Segmented Square Tally (![][image43] adjacent 24×24px 2px-framed boxes) \+ Dual Monospace Ratio (04/06 BƯỚC · 110/165 PHÚT)**. Completed boxes invert to solid \#14181d ink. | Used on SCR-DB-01 (Block 1), SCR-LP-01 header, SCR-PRAC-01..03 Gate Banner. **Prohibited**: Never render weekly steps as a continuous smooth percentage bar1. |
| **3\. Intra-Session / Intra-Step Item Progress** | Small finite ordered sequence ![][image72] where ![][image73] items or ![][image74] tasks (FR-STEP-05, FR-TRANS-01). | \*\*Numbered Item Index Strip (\`01 | 02 |
| **4\. Topic Capability & Rubric Criterion Standing** | Beta-Binomial posterior ![][image75] classified into \`unmeasured | low | developing |

Every screen must use a single, invariant vocabulary and visual treatment to communicate system and learner states (§6.6 Q17)1. In accordance with §4 (*"Colour is a second layer of information, always paired with a word or a number — never colour alone"*), every state combines a specific border and surface treatment, a drawn SVG icon, and a canonical Vietnamese uppercase placard1.

| **2\. Locked by Sequence / Gate** | \[CHƯA MỞ KHÓA\] (locked) | \#eef0f1 wall fill, 1px solid \#ccd2d6 frame, \#5c6570 text, lock SVG icon. | Names the exact prerequisite that unlocks it ("Mở sau khi hoàn thành Bước 04" or "Mở khi xong 02 bước còn lại của Tuần 03")1. |
| **3\. Currently Doing / Active** | \[ĐANG THỰC HIỆN\] (in\_progress) | **Active Selection**: Solid \#14181d ink fill with \#ffffff text (§4), or \#ffffff panel with 2px solid \#0b4ea2 Sign Blue active ring. | Prints saved progress count (Đã lưu 04/10 câu) \+ action TIẾP TỤC LÀM1. |
| **4\. Completed / Closed** | \[ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH\] (closed / measured) | \#ffffff fill, 2px solid \#14181d frame, \#0a6b3c Sign Green check SVG \+ badge. | Prints completion timestamp and outcome (Đúng 08/10 câu · Đã nâng mức thành thạo) \+ secondary link XEM LẠI GIẢI THÍCH1. |

Never greyed out; never shows a low band. | States that the system failed to grade after retries (not learner refusal) and provides a zero-cost CHẤM LẠI MIỄN PHÍ button (U11, BR-AI-02)1. |
